newsitem.title: PERU: Two children die, five hurt in Peru grenade blast.
newsitem.headline: Two children die, five hurt in Peru grenade blast.

text.p: Two Peruvian children were killed and five other people were injured on Friday when a grenade the children were playing with exploded at a market in a poor Lima neighbourhood, police and local radio said.
"We know two minors were handling an explosive and that it went off," a police bomb squad spokesman said.
Police said the accident was under investigation.
Local radio said the children, aged 12 and 14, found the grenade along the banks of the nearby Rimac River and were taking it to the Zarate market where they worked when it exploded.
